question.text: An SIA reviewing the constitutive documents of a Section 8 Company needs to confirm the minimum shareholder and director requirement. What is the minimum prescribed under the Companies Act 2013?

answer.text: 2 directors and 2 shareholders (directors may also be shareholders)
10 members with a Board of Trustees

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the Companies Act 2013, a Section 8 Company requires a minimum of 2 directors and 2 shareholders; the directors may also act as shareholders. This contrasts with a Society (7 members, 5 in J&K) and a Trust (2 trustees minimum). The Trap: Option A applies to a Trust. Option B applies to a Society. Option D is a fabricated hybrid structure. The quiz frequently mixes these up — make sure to match the legal form to the minimum-membership rule. Cross-Exam Context: Cross-links to Ch 11 (Key Regulations) and to III-A (Compliance) for annual RoC filings. SIAs reference these minimums during governance-adequacy checks.
